purpose: Teach: 帆/ニンニク/アダプタ/槍/ゴマ/えび/復刻/仮面ライダー

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、帆船のお絵を描いてらしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: A customer came in and drew such a lovely sailboat picture, Aoi.
lines.style: Warm, noticing tone. Soft attack. Gentle pace—savoring the small moment. Slight lift at the end, like sharing something precious but not making a big deal of it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、ニンニク入りスープ作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: Let's put garlic in the soup for the new menu item, Aoi.
lines.style: Bright, forward momentum. Quick decision-maker's pace. Warmth mixed with enthusiasm—collaborative, already imagining it. No hesitation.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の電源、アダプタが新しくなったね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The café got a new power adapter, didn't it—I noticed that today.
lines.style: Quiet observation, almost to herself. Slight wonder in the tone—noticing the small improvements. Gentle fade at the end, like she's thinking out loud with someone she trusts.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お祭りで槍の演武を見たわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Oh, I saw a spear demonstration at the festival the other day, it was incredible.
lines.style: Lit up with shared memory. Quick, animated delivery. Slight bounce in the pace—wanting to bring Aoi into that moment. Genuine delight underneath.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、ゴマだれの和え物にしましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: What if we made the new dish a sesame-dressed vegetable plate instead?
lines.style: Thoughtful suggestion, not directive. Soft opening. Measured pace—giving the idea room to land. Seeking agreement, not asserting. Light, open ending.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、えびのフライ作りましょう、メイちゃん
lines.en: We should definitely add shrimp tempura to the new menu—it'll be perfect.
lines.style: Confident, already sold on the idea. Quick, bright pace. Forward-leaning energy. The certainty of someone who knows what will work. No doubt.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、レトロな看板、復刻したいね、メイちゃん
lines.en: That old retro sign outside—wouldn't it be wonderful if we brought it back?
lines.style: Wistful but grounded. Slower pace. Soft landing on the question. Genuine nostalgia underneath—not lost in it, but genuinely moved by it.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お子様、仮面ライダーのお菓子を選んでらっしゃるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: There was a child in here earlier choosing one of those Kamen Rider snacks—so happy about it.
lines.style: Warm, pleased recollection. Gentle pace with a small smile underneath. The satisfaction of witnessing simple joy. Quiet, closed ending—content observation.
